0022600121.text: The Boston Celtics, 1-1 and third in the Atlantic Division, host the Chicago Bulls, who are also 1-1 and second in the Central, in the Celtics' third game of the 2026-27 season. Boston is 1-0 at home and 0-1 on the road, while Chicago is 1-1 on the road and sits eighth in the East, one game behind the Atlantic's leader. Devin Carter is out for Boston with an illness, while Chicago is without Nic Claxton (hamstring), Noa Essengue (head bruise) and Patrick Williams (groin soreness).
